topic: Pick a board game to buy for the break room

scenario.topic: Pick a board game to buy for the break room
scenario.opening_question: What matters more for our break room game: quick fun or deeper strategy?

options.name: Ticket to Ride Europe
options.upside: Engaging strategic gameplay with moderate length
options.tradeoff: Longer setup and playtime may not fit short breaks
options.concern: May be too complex for casual players during quick breaks
options.best_for: players who enjoy strategic planning and longer sessions

options.name: Codenames Duet
options.upside: Quick, cooperative gameplay ideal for short breaks
options.tradeoff: Less depth and replayability compared to heavier games
options.concern: May get repetitive after frequent plays
options.best_for: players who want fast, easy-to-learn cooperative fun

options.name: Jaipur Card Game
options.upside: Fast-paced two-player trading game with good replay value
options.tradeoff: Limited to two players, so less flexible for group play
options.concern: May not engage those looking for deeper strategy
options.best_for: two players wanting a quick, competitive card game

options.name: Splendor Board Game
options.upside: Elegant engine-building game with simple rules and strategic depth
options.tradeoff: Slightly higher cost and may take longer to master
options.concern: Not ideal if players want very casual or very quick games
options.best_for: players who enjoy strategy with moderate complexity and quick setup

shared_context: Break room has limited space for game setup

personas.name: Oscar
personas.background: I prefer games that balance strategic depth with moderate complexity to keep the break room engaging but not overwhelming.
personas.private_goal: I want a game that supports strategic thinking and can be enjoyed in moderate-length sessions during breaks.

personas.name: Rina
personas.background: I value quick, easy-to-learn cooperative games that fit well into short breaks and encourage teamwork.
personas.private_goal: I want a game that is fast to play and accessible to everyone, even casual players.
